Thanks for the call today — appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned:

- Recap of ask: Finexa wants to validate security posture (SOC 2, pen test, audit logging) and understand data retention/segregation for PII. You also asked about procurement timing and who the economic buyer is for the production rollout.

- Action items we have from our side: share SOC 2 report and pen test summary, provide sanitized audit log sample and a short note on data retention/retention policy, and share our standard security addendum/flow for procurement.

Can you confirm: 1) who the economic buyer is (name/title), 2) expected procurement timeline (SOW/PO/contract), and 3) whether Finexa needs additional attestations (e.g., encryption key custody, dedicated instance)?

Proposed next step: I can send the security artifacts by EOD Monday and propose a 30m joint session with DevSecOps to walk through artifacts and answer questions — would Wed 2/24 or Thu 2/25 work?

Thanks — Ben
